packages.// name: Stable package id. Also the folder name Brewstore uses when no explicit target is set.
packages.name: example-source
packages.// title: Name shown in the shop; falls back to name when omitted.
packages.title: Example Homebrew
packages.// author: Shown under the title; falls back to Unknown when omitted.
packages.author: Example Author
packages.// description: Shop card and detail text; keep it short and factual.
packages.description: A sample catalog entry. Replace the URL and icon with a real package archive.
packages.// icon: HTTPS image URL only; the console downloads and caches it.
packages.// version: Displayed version. The update workflow refreshes it from the release tag.
packages.// url: GitHub/GitLab repository URL. Direct archive URLs can be used instead.
packages.// release: Presence enables GitHub/GitLab release lookup; its value is not otherwise interpreted.
packages.// asset: Asset filename suffix to download. Empty means pick a .nro or archive automatically.
packages.// branch: Branch used for README description fallback and for direct repository archive URLs.
packages.// sha256: SHA-256 of the exact downloaded asset; empty means no pre-download check. The workflow fills it.
packages.// published: Release time in Unix seconds, used by the Updated sort; the workflow refreshes it.
packages.// target: Fixed install path. Omit this to honor the user's Default install path (normally sdmc:/brewstore/apps/<name>).
packages.// stripPrefix: Archive folder to remove before extraction, so files land directly in target.
packages.// marker: File that proves the package is installed; also used to detect updates for root/archive installs.
packages.// shortcut: true creates an hbmenu shortcut; false is for launchers or packages that must not add one.

packages.// name: A second package id; each manifest normally contains exactly one package.
packages.name: direct-archive
packages.// title: Displayed even when the source is a direct download.
packages.title: Direct Archive
packages.author: Example Author
packages.// description: Explains that this entry downloads a URL instead of resolving a repository release.
packages.description: Shows a direct archive URL instead of a GitHub repository URL.
packages.// icon: Empty is allowed; Brewstore draws a placeholder instead of downloading an icon.
packages.// version: Direct downloads have no release tag to read, so keep this current manually.
packages.// url: Any HTTPS archive URL works here; no GitHub release lookup is performed.
packages.// asset: Still used to name and select the downloaded file for direct URLs.
packages.// branch: Unused for a direct codeload URL; kept here so the entry shows the complete schema.
packages.// sha256: Strongly recommended for direct URLs because there is no release API to verify against.
packages.// published: Optional timestamp for sorting; use the upload/build time in Unix seconds.
packages.// target: Omit to use the user's Default install path; set only when the app hardcodes a location.
packages.// stripPrefix: Removes the archive's top-level folder; leave empty when the archive already has the final layout.
packages.// marker: Recommended so an interrupted extraction is not reported as a working install.
packages.// shortcut: Set false when the target is the SD root or another launcher owns the entry point.
